How To Play

Moving your checkers

  • You play the ivory checkers. Move them around the board toward your home board at the bottom right (points 1 to 6).
  • One click moves a checker by your larger die.
  • Right-click moves it by your smaller die instead.
  • To put a checker on any other spot, drag it there. While you hold it, gold rings show every spot it can reach, including moves that use both dice.
  • If the larger die can't be used for that checker, one click uses the die that works.
  • Bear off by clicking a checker in your home board, or dragging it to the tray on the right.

Your turn

  • Press Roll Dice (or the Space bar) to roll.
  • When your moves are made, press Done (or Enter). Press Undo to take your moves back before you're done.
  • If a checker of yours is on the bar, you must bring it in first.

Doubling

  • Before you roll, you can press Double to double the stakes. She can take it, or drop it and give you the game.
  • She can double you too. Take and keep playing, or drop and give up the current stakes.
  • A gammon (the loser has borne off no checkers) counts double. A backgammon counts triple.

Winning

  • First to bear off all 15 checkers wins the game. First to reach the match points wins the match.
